financial_period: Q2 and H1 2026 ended 2026-06-30; TTM reconstructed through 2026-06-30

quote.source: Robinhood get_equity_quotes, public market data only

business_evidence: Search and Cloud growth support retaining an existing long-horizon investment. Cloud operating profitability is improving; business momentum alone does not establish a bargain.
normalization: Investment marks dominate headline EPS. Cash capex and stock compensation depress distributable cash; maintenance/growth capex is not separated. The cash proxy omits a full preference, lease, acquisition and capital-commitment bridge. Latest quarter weighted shares are not a forecast of post-conversion or future ATM dilution.
fundamental_review_conditions: Change HOLD toward TRIM/EXIT if Search revenue declines year over year in two successive reported quarters and Cloud operating-profit gains fail to offset the resulting decline in consolidated operating income. Two quarters is an analyst confirmation rule, not a proven loss limit; an abrupt documented structural impairment warrants immediate review.

Change HOLD toward TRIM/EXIT if repeated additional financing or common-share issuance is needed while trailing post-capex cash flow deteriorates and reported evidence no longer supports profitable capacity absorption. Reconcile the full capital structure before an amount is proposed.
Review immediately after a verified regulatory order materially changes Search distribution or ad economics; quantify the earnings effect instead of selling on an unverified headline.

Consider ADD-WATCH only after a normalized common-share cash model incorporates investment requirements, lease commitments, mandatory-convertible terms, updated net financing and a credible downside case, and shows adequate prospective return at the then-current quote.
interpretation: There is room for the business to grow, but GAAP EPS is a poor shortcut to cheapness this quarter. Retain the existing position provisionally; require better cash-return evidence before adding. No specific sale price is supported by these diagnostics.

valuation_model.horizon_status: 3-5 years working assumption pending user preference
valuation_model.owner_cash_flow_proxy: TTM operating cash flow minus cash property/equipment purchases minus stock compensation, divided by latest-quarter diluted weighted-average shares. An economic diagnostic before a complete common-equity and preferred-security bridge, not full FCFE.
valuation_model.formula: P = sum(F0*(1+g)^t/(1+r)^t, t=1..5) + M*F0*(1+g)^5/(1+r)^5; solve g for reference price P.
valuation_model.assumption_rationale: 10%/12% returns and 20/25/30x terminal cash multiples are analyst sensitivities, not promises or a claim the multiples are deserved. Current investment spending can make the growth requirement unusually large.
valuation_model.share_treatment: Use 12,309 million latest-quarter diluted weighted-average shares; freeze shares solely for comparability. SBC is deducted economically, with no extra assumed buyback benefit or second dilution charge. Future financing issuance and full mandatory-convertible terms remain unresolved; weighted if-converted shares are not full future shares.
valuation_model.cash_debt_treatment: No excess-cash, SpaceX stake or other investment value added, and no second debt subtraction from interest-bearing cash flows. June cash includes marketable securities with restrictions and is not current excess cash; August added $25B of notes. Do not subtract all debt while retaining no proceeds or call this an equity valuation.
valuation_model.distribution_treatment: No separate common dividends or buybacks counted; model cash is assumed distributable for sensitivity. Preferred dividends/claims and financing/lease obligations still need full treatment before a common-stock price target.
valuation_model.timing: Five full future annual periods without a fiscal-date stub.
valuation_model.sell_policy: No mechanical sale on a chart or model cell. Apply documented business, valuation or portfolio-risk evidence.

earnings_cross_check.starting_diagnostic: Four times Q2 EPS after removing only the issuer-disclosed equity-gain EPS effect; seasonal, tax, legal and capital-structure effects remain. Not normalized annual earnings.
earnings_cross_check.formula: Required year-5 EPS = P*(1+r)^5/terminal_PE; CAGR compares this to the explicitly hypothetical annualized Q2 base.
earnings_cross_check.dividend_treatment: No dividends or investment/cash value added; total return would differ if distributions occur.
earnings_cross_check.interpretation: Cash and earnings diagnostics diverge because heavy capex, financing and gains complicate conversion from operating growth to common-share cash returns. Resolve this before declaring a fair value.

news_review.scope: SEC current submissions, latest 10-Q, Aug10 financing 8-K, issuer IR pages and bounded primary-product search
news_review.product_update: September10 Google Ads measurement tools announcement; no quantified Alphabet cash-flow forecast used.
news_review.limitations: IR dynamically rendered news feed was incomplete. Secondary September2 ad-tech-remedy headlines were not verified in a current primary order and are not relied on as regulatory clearance. This is a bounded research check, not a comprehensive legal/news clearance.

regulatory_followup.queries: Three bounded search batches covering DOJ, EDVA court, Google company response and docket indexing; direct DOJ case index read.
regulatory_followup.verified_observation: DOJ 2023 ad-tech case page returned remedy proposals and briefs from 2025, with page updated December26 2025. This older page does not establish present case status.
regulatory_followup.case_disambiguation: The readily found DOJ September2 2025 remedies announcement concerns Search, not the reported September2 2026 ad-tech decision.
regulatory_followup.unverified_secondary_context: A September2 2026 report says the written ad-tech ruling is temporarily sealed; this was not verified in a primary docket.
regulatory_followup.decision_effect: HOLD / DO NOT ADD unchanged. No relief from regulatory risk or change to valuation assumed; require current written terms before estimating operating impact.

research_stance.reason: Search and Cloud growth support continued ownership; common-share cash returns after investment and financing need stronger evidence before adding.
research_stance.scope: General company research; no personal positions, costs or account details.
